0|68b38550ddbea13d296184bf69edff387618b1d3|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"Btrfs: change how we unpin extents
We are racy with async block caching and unpinning extents.  This patch makes
things much less complicated by only unpinning the extent if the block group is
cached.  We check the block_group->cached var under the block_group->lock spin
lock.  If it is set to BTRFS_CACHE_FINISHED then we update the pinned counters
and unpin the extent and add the free space back.  If it is not set to this
start the caching of the block group so the next time we unpin extents we can
unpin the extent.  This keeps us from racing with the async caching threads
lets us kill the fs wide async thread counter
column2: and keeps us from having to set

column1: DELALLOC bits for every extent we hit if there are caching kthreads going.
One thing that needed to be changed was btrfs_free_super_mirror_extents.  Now
instead of just looking for LOCKED extents
column2: we also look for DIRTY extents

column1: since we could have left some extents pinned in the previous transaction that
will never get freed now that we are unmounting
column2: which would cause us to leak

column1: memory.  So btrfs_free_super_mirror_extents has been changed to
btrfs_free_pinned_extents
column2: and it will clear the extents locked for the super

column1: mirror
column2: and any remaining pinned extents that may be present.  Thank you
